business.reason: Existing authorization, version, state and effect expectations are preserved. The archive UI is inventoried as existing implemented behavior, not a new requested rule.

state_machine.reason: The executor and generator now read the same machine JSON. Runtime declaration parity against the previous frozen definitions and real wait/resource/join behavior is tested.

abstraction.reason: Common services are grouped under bo_observer; Python and native sources use one inventory. Obsolete viewers and v1 schemas are retired; stable source IDs remain.

probes.reason: Versioned native JSON transport joins the same event stream. Observer infrastructure remains excluded. The archive UI adds actual DOM handler tests and request-value checks; previous probes and checks are retained.
